text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: latency_slo_v2 > 30% burn over 10m. p95 = 760ms, p99 = 2.4s. Routing: hosted-api-eu-west. PagerDuty incident PD-65321 created and auto-paged.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident PD-65321 fired for service "redwood-hosted-api" (urgency: high). Trigger: latency_slo_v2. Links: https://pd.example/PD-65321
Priya (oncall): acked PD-65321 :thumbsup: I’m looking. Any obvious deploys?
Leo: no recent deploys to hosted-api-eu-west in the last 30m. Alerts show spike correlating with a traffic bump from partner X (X-prod).
Jun: metrics: request qps +65% last 12m. KV-cache hit-rate dropped from 84% -> 21% at the same time. Possible cache invalidation or eviction storm.
Marta: confirming errors? SLO burn is latency-only, error rate stable. No 5xx spike in the dashboards.
Priya (oncall): good. Focus on latency. Can we temporarily divert traffic to eu-central or fall back to smaller model variants?
Leo: routing policy allows fallthrough to eu-central and to model-variant small-2. But capacity in eu-central is near max. We can enable fallthrough + prefer small-2 to reduce per-request latency. Need ops approval to change routing.
Priya (oncall): ops-bot, can we patch routing policy to enable model-variant fallback and prefer eu-central for 10m?
ops-bot: Routing change request acknowledged. Proposed change: add route rule "latency-emergency-fallback" with priority to model small-2 and region eu-central for 10m. Requires 1 approver.
Jun: I can approve. Quick note: small-2 reduces max token length; some requests may truncate. Notify downstream.
Marta: approving routing change. Do it Priya.
Priya (oncall): applying change now (CLI):
```
# add emergency fallback rule
rwctl route add --name latency-emergency-fallback --match "region==eu-west && slo_burn>20" --prefer "model:small-2,region:eu-central" --ttl 600
```
Priya (oncall): applied. Observability: enabling extra tracing for slow tails.
Leo: confirming traffic shift starting in ~30s. p95 dropped to 420ms in eu-west for cached requests, overall p95 -> 520ms after fallthrough. p99 still ~1.5-1.9s.
Jun: KV-cache eviction reason: a recent job cleared prefixes for partner X to flush stale contexts. That job overlapped heavy traffic. I’ll throttle or stagger the flush job next time.
Priya (oncall): noted. Can we temporarily increase instance count on hosted-api-eu-west to absorb remaining tail? What’s the autoscaler headroom?
Leo: autoscaler had hit target; we can temporarily bump reserved replicas:
```
# scale up pool
rwctl pool scale --pool hosted-api-eu-west --replicas 12
```
Leo: scaling up now. ETA ~90s for new instances.
Marta: customer impact: partner X saw increased response times and reported degraded UX. Internal monitoring shows ~3% of production requests exceeded 2s. No outages.
Priya (oncall): posting an incident note to the incident page, tagging cs to notify partner X and recommend retry/backoff adjustments.
pagerduty: PD-65321 acknowledged by Priya (oncall). Escalation suppressed.
Jun: scale completed. New instances healthy. p95 -> 310ms, p99 -> 680ms. SLO burn reduced to 6% over 10m.
Priya (oncall): good stabilization. I’m going to run a short short-term canary: revert routing fallback and keep scaled instances for 10m. If SLO stays OK, we’ll revert scale.
Marta: please include timeline and customer impact in the incident summary. I’ll draft the postmortem skeleton once this is stable.
Priya (oncall): actions logged: 1) applied model/region fallback for 10m; 2) scaled hosted-api-eu-west to 12 replicas for 10m; 3) traced and flagged partner X cache flush job; 4) notified partner X CS.
Leo: follow-up: add guard to cache flush job to only run below 30% qps or apply gradual eviction. Also add metric for prefix-flush events tied to partner id.
Jun: will open PR for flush guard and a dashboard alert when flush count spikes.
Priya (oncall): closing the active page now as PD shows acknowledged and SLO burn <10% sustained. Will keep this thread open for handoff to SRE shift in 30m.
pagerduty: PD-65321 status: acknowledged -> resolved (by Priya). Resolution note: routing fallback + scale up mitigated SLO burn.
Marta: :white_check_mark: thanks team. Assigning post-incident follow-ups: Jun (cache flush guard), Leo (routing policy playbook update), Priya (incident timeline + customer outreach).
Priya (oncall): handing off to next on-call (Ava). Ava: please monitor tail latency and confirm remediation persists.
Ava (oncall): acked. I’ll watch dashboards and confirm by end of shift.
Priya (oncall): end of thread update: incident summary posted: https://wiki.example/incidents/PD-65321.
